p: the trumpet in Zion: He shows the great judgments of God which are at hand, unless they repent.
day of darkness and of gloominess: Of affliction and trouble.
great people and a strong: Meaning, the Assyrians.
Eden before them: The enemy destroyed our plentiful country, wherever he went.
shall gather blackness: They will be pale and black because of fear, as in Na 2:10.
thrust another: For none will be able to resist them.
sun and the moon shall be: Read Joe 2:31; Isa 13:10; Eze 32:7; Joe 3:15; Mt 24:29
utter his voice before his army: The Lord will stir up the Assyrians to execute his judgments.
rend your heart: Mortify your affections and serve God with pureness of heart, and not with ceremonies.
return and repent: He speaks this to stir up their slothfulness, and not that he doubted of God's mercies, if they did repent. For the way in which God repents, read Geneva "Jer 18:8"

children: That as all have sinned, so all may show forth signs of their repentance, so that men seeing the children who are not free from God's wrath, might be the more deeply touched with the consideration of their own sins.
jealous for his land: If they repent he shows that God will preserve and defend them with a most fervent affection.
northern army: That is, the Assyrians your enemies.
east sea: Called the Salt Sea, or Persian Sea: meaning, that even though this army was so great that it filled all from this sea to the Mediterranean Sea, yet he would scatter them.
moderately: That is, such as would come by just measure, and would be sent when God was reconciled with them.

out my spirit upon all flesh: That is, in greater abundance, and more broadly than in times past. And this was fulfilled under Christ, when God's graces and his Spirit under the Gospel were abundantly given to the Church; Isa 44:3; Ac 2:17 Joh 7:38-39.
dreams: As they had visions and dreams in ancient times, so will they now have clearer revelations.

wonders in the heavens and in: He warns the faithful what terrible things would come, with the intent that they should not look for continual quietness in this world: and yet in all these troubles he would preserve them.
sun shall be turned into darkness: The order of nature will seem to be changed because of the horrible afflictions that will be in the world; Isa 13:10; Eze 32:7; Joe 3:15; Mt 24:29.
on the name of the LORD: God's judgments are for the destruction of the unbelievers, and to exhort the godly to call upon the name of God, who will give them salvation.
remnant whom the LORD shall call: Meaning the Gentiles by this; Ro 10:13.
